description: Read a focused design view: sessions (no designId), overview, decisions, graph, rules, focus, or next. Pin revision on first read; continuations must match. Does not create sessions.

componentId.description: Alternative design session ID alias matching designId.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for paginated context listings.

designId.description: Target design session ID (required for all views except "sessions").

id.description: Alternative design session ID alias matching designId.

name.description: Alternative design session ID alias matching designId.

nodeId.description: Target node ID within the page (for "node" view).

pageId.description: Target page ID within the design session (for "page" or "node" view).

revision.description: Target design session revision to inspect (defaults to latest).

view.description: Context perspective to retrieve: "sessions", "overview", "decisions", "graph", "rules", "focus", or "next". Defaults to "sessions".

name: get_design_context
